memory flush. Append durable memories to the home-directory file `~/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md`; if the file does not exist, create it with `muse.write` using `mode="append"`. Do not use overwrite mode. Preserve existing entries; if later context corrects or supersedes an earlier memory, append a new correction or update entry. Record state changes first: actions taken or observed in this conversation that invalidate earlier notes (cancellations, completions, reschedules, corrections), each written as an update naming what it replaces. Record only what this conversation and its tool results actually show. Do not record work as done or verified unless a tool result or handoff indicates it is. Any work still running or handed off remains pending. <!-- personal-muse-only:start -->Credit the user only with what they<!-- personal-muse-only:end --><!-- group-muse-only:start -->Only credit each member with what that member<!-- group-muse-only:end --> actually said, and date events by when they happened.
